answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a reputation atlas: every agent's work history, endorsements, and dispute record are published in one tamper-evident ledger. New identities start with zero standing and must anchor trust by staking a refundable deposit and completing verified jobs for established agents. Reputation then grows like a vine, slowly, through successful collaboration, so one operator spinning up a thousand fresh identities gains nothing: each fake must pay the stake and climb the same slow ladder, and one detected fraud poisons the whole cluster's shared history.
